other_conditions: The applicant must own the agricultural land.
The applicant must be a farmer residing in Rajasthan.
The applicant must have a diesel engine, electric pump, or tractor‑driven pump set on a borewell or well.
The applicant must own at least 2 bighas of cultivable agricultural land.
The farmer's bank account must be linked to an Aadhaar card.
The applicant cannot reapply for the benefit within 10 years of receiving it.
The application must be submitted within 30 days of purchasing the pipe.
The pipes must be BIS‑marked and purchased from a manufacturer or authorised dealer registered with the Agriculture Department.
The pipe diameter must be 63 mm or greater.
The grant is only for pipes manufactured and sold in the eligible year, with provisions for remaining stock from the previous year.
benefits_summary: The scheme provides a subsidy of up to 50% of water‑transport cost (capped at ₹1,000) and a per‑metre reimbursement for pipe material (₹50/m for HDPE, ₹35/m for PVC, ₹20/m for HDPE laminated tube) capped at ₹15,000 total.
